The '''Civilian Pressure''' located in [[Graith]] provided [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] and offices for travelling businessbeings and entrepreneurs. [[Restaurant/Legends|Restaurants]], shops, and a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] were located along the [[pressure]]'s Central Concourse.
